hits.title: Alloy Raises A$11.5M Seed
hits.snippet: Alloy Raises A$11.5M Seed Alloy, based in Australia, is a software platform designed to build the intelligence layer for robotics fleets. The company recently raised A$11.5 million in a seed funding round, bringing its valuation to A$115 million. ## Investors The round was led by Square Peg, with continued support from Blackbird and Airtree. ## Alloy Use of Funds Alloy plans to use the capital to invest ahead of current demand by expanding its global presence, with a particular focus on the United States. The company will also grow its implementation and support teams, continue investing in its Mesh Storage and edge infrastructure, and deepen its robotics-specific intelligence and evaluation capabilities. ## About Alloy Founded in 2025 by Joe Harris, Alloy provides a robotics-specific data layer that allows engineering teams to ingest and analyze fragmented data from logs, images, and sensors. The platform aims to help engineers debug robotic systems and improve performance across the entire development lifecycle, from R&D to field deployment. ## Funding Details Company Website: [https://usealloy.ai](https://usealloy.ai/?ref=thesaasnews.com) Company: Alloy Raised: A$11.5M Round: Se
